item.title: NLC India Moves A step Closer to Listing Green Energy Subsidiary
item.description: NLC India’s Board of Directors has considered and granted in-principle approval for the listing of NLC India Renewables Limited (NIRL), a subsidiary of NLC India Limited. In a regulatory filing, the company stated that this move aligns with the Indian government’s National Monetisation Pipeline targets and will be carried out through the dilution of up to a 25% equity stake in one or more tranches via a public offer, subject to obtaining the requisite approvals from the competent authorities. item.title: Solar In 2026- Expert Predictions
item.description: As we approach 2026, the global solar market is entering its most complex phase yet. item.title: Automakers Eye Tariff Relief as EU Opens Door to Minimum Price Deals for Chinese-Built EVs
item.description: The European Commission and China's Ministry of Commerce unveiled joint guidance on Monday that paves the way for lifting tariffs on select electric vehicles (EVs) imported from China to Europe. item.title: NLC India and Gujarat Government Ink ₹25,000 Crore Renewable Energy Pact
item.description: State-owned NLC India Limited (NLCIL) has announced a partnership with the Government of Gujarat to develop large-scale renewable energy projects. This collaboration, formalised through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), involves an estimated investment of ₹25,000 crore, representing one of the most significant green energy initiatives in the state this year. item.title: REC Invites Bids for Inter-State P2P Power Trading Pilot Using India Energy Stack
item.description: REC has issued a tender inviting bids from eligible Technology Solution Providers (TSPs) with proven expertise in power markets, digital platforms, energy systems, and fintech. It has sought bids voluntarily to participate in an India Energy Stack (IES) pilot focused on enabling an inter-state peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading use case. item.title: Indofast Energy Partners with Mumbai Metro to Launch 23 Battery-Swapping Stations
item.description: Indofast Energy, a battery-swapping solutions provider, has announced a landmark partnership with the Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MMRCL) to establish a network of 23 battery-swapping stations. The infrastructure will be located along the Mumbai Metro Aqua Line 3 corridor, a critical north-south line for the city. item.description: Oswal Pumps, a vertically integrated solar pump manufacturer, has received an order with a total order value of ₹119.92 crore (inclusive of GST) from Karnataka Renewable Energy Development Limited (KREDL) under the PM-KUSUM B Scheme. item.title: L&T Secures 3,000 MW Saidongar-1 PSP Order From Torrent in Maharashtra
item.description: Larsen & Toubro's (L&T) Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical has secured a large order from Torrent Energy Storage Solutions Pvt Ltd (earlier known as Torrent PSH 3 Pvt Ltd) to construct the 3,000 MW Saidongar-1 Pumped Storage Project (PSP) in Raigad, Maharashtra. item.title: Wind O&M Specialist GreenTech Secures INR 30 Crore in Funding Led by Transition VC
item.description: GreenTech, a tech-driven operations and maintenance (O&M) firm specialising in wind turbine asset management, announced that it has raised INR 30 crore in its first funding round. The investment, a strategic mix of equity and debt, was led entirely by Transition VC, India’s first venture capital fund dedicated to the energy transition.
